_comment: What this build depends on: fetched by the run that needs it, never
committed. One entry today. anoieu owns the policy this repository
declares it follows, and its checker is what CI runs, so it is a
dependency of the build in the ordinary sense.
A `ref` is a choice, not a fact: it says which branch we intend to
track. Which commit of that branch we are actually checked against is
tools/deps.lock, moved by scripts/bump_anoieu and never by hand.
No `paths` entry, unlike anoieu's own manifest: the whole repository is
a few hundred kilobytes of text and a shallow clone of it is cheaper
than the sparse-checkout machinery that would narrow it.

anoieu.reads: tools/policy_check.py, and the policy document it implements
